title: Uncaught ImportError on missing vendor module
detail: The function now returns a ModuleType but does not handle ImportError. If the vendor module does not exist, importlib.import_module will raise ImportError, causing the program to crash.

title: Unconditional assert on module.__file__
detail: Modules loaded from zip files or built‑in modules may not have a __file__ attribute, causing an AssertionError and crashing the program.
